_source: David (owner), Slack, 2026-09-07 — PAC-91 §8 'Owner decisions', plus the three duplicate-household merges decided 2026-09-09 (§10 follow-up). Applied by backfill-household-links.ts under --apply-owner-decisions, so the rehearsal and the production run apply exactly the same list.
_keys: Records are named by their SmartSuite title (#HH…/#C…/policy number) so the list stays reviewable by the owner. `recordId` is the SmartSuite record id the script actually joins on (Mongo `legacySmartSuiteId`); the script asserts the two still agree in the export before writing anything.
